decisions.reason: The source defines the interboard power path and power connectors, not the separate signal connector or its pinout.
The power-distribution topology does not change I2C cable, pull-up, speed, or series-resistor requirements.
The source does not assign or change any ESP32-S3 GPIO.
The source describes power routing and current measurement, not USB data lines or native USB programming.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the INA219 placement and total downstream 3.3V measurement coverage, so no additional or edited Event is required.
The source does not change charge-status indication, its LED connector, or resistor population.
The interboard power chain does not alter the panel reset connector or its electrical action.
The established three-board architecture and board roles remain valid; the detailed power-chain topology is independently owned by the interboard power Requirement.
The candidate already requires the complete 3.3V rail and listed downstream loads to be powered during standalone USB operation; the source does not change that mode or its source-selection rule.
The source does not change any panel button, switch, connector, or GPIO assignment.
The source does not change whether or how the PIR input connector is provided.
The source specifically establishes the 3.3V distribution and INA219 measurement path; it does not change the switched 5V rail, its enable control, or its loads.
